PhonePe Secures UAE Central Bank Approval for Payment Services

Fintech company PhonePe has received in-principle approval from the UAE central bank for two licenses. These licenses cover retail payments, card schemes, and stored value facilities. PhonePe requires final regulatory approval before commencing commercial operations in the UAE.
